AI.conclusion: PSD 为在无法访问闭源教师内部信息的条件下，利用小模型构建分层记忆表示提供了可行方案，兼顾性能与部署成本，并展现出良好的分布外泛化能力。

title: Rule-Constrained Assignment for Cue-Ball Identification in Broadcast Snooker
summary: Accurate cue-ball identification is essential for metric analysis of broadcast snooker. Existing systems evaluate each candidate independently against a fixed white prototype and reject candidates above an appearance threshold. Under broadcast conditions, illumination changes can make colored balls appear white, while intrusions from players and equipment can obscure the cue ball or introduce competing candidates. We formulate cue-ball identification as a rule-constrained assignment problem that jointly assigns detected candidates to the bounded snooker inventory: one cue ball, up to 15 reds, and six colors with known spots. The cue ball is selected by the incremental cost of assigning each candidate to the white slot, and the conventional appearance test follows as the one-slot case. On 419 hand-annotated shots, our method improves identity accuracy from 88.1% to 95.5%, and from 80.5% to 95.2% on held-out venues. Within CueLift, our metric state-recovery system, the assignment expands coverage from 36.2% to 55.4% over 6,241 scorable shots. Assigning an estimate to every shot in a separate evaluation on 2,529 shots preserves this advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文将母球识别重构为规则约束的分配问题，联合分配候选球至斯诺克有界球种清单，显著提升识别准确率与度量恢复覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 广播斯诺克度量分析依赖准确的母球识别。现有系统对每个候选独立与固定白色原型比对，并以外观阈值拒绝候选；但广播条件下光照变化会使彩球显白，球员与设备遮挡会遮蔽母球或引入竞争候选，导致识别不稳。
AI.method: 将母球识别建模为规则约束的分配问题，将检测到的候选球联合分配至有界斯诺克球种清单：1个母球、最多15个红球以及6个已知位置的彩球。母球通过将每个候选分配至白色槽位的增量成本来选取，传统外观检验作为单槽情形的特例。
AI.result: 在419个手工标注击球上，身份准确率从88.1%提升至95.5%；在留出场地从80.5%提升至95.2%。在度量状态恢复系统CueLift中，分配方法在6,241个可计分击球上将覆盖率从36.2%扩展至55.4%。在2,529个击球的独立评估中为每个击球分配估计值仍保持该优势。
AI.conclusion: 规则约束的联合分配框架优于逐候选独立外观判定，既提高母球身份准确率，又提升下游度量状态恢复覆盖率，并在跨场地与独立评估中保持一致优势。

title: Long-Tail Rebalancing for Non-Verbal Vocalization-Aware ASR: A Track 1 System for the NVVSpeech Challenge
comment: Accepted by ISCSLP 2026, NVVSpeech Challenge Track 1
summary: Non-verbal vocalizations (NVVs) carry important paralinguistic information but are often omitted by conventional automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems. The ISCSLP NVVSpeech Challenge requires joint transcription of lexical content and 16 NVV categories under limited and highly imbalanced supervision. We present a data-centric NVV-aware ASR pipeline based on cross-dataset label harmonization and a two-stage sampling schedule. We map heterogeneous source labels to the official taxonomy and exclude samples without a reliable mapping. Our schedule first uses square-root category sampling to moderate the long-tailed distribution and then applies uniform-category fine-tuning. On a fixed local validation split, square-root category sampling performs best among the tested single-stage settings. The final two-stage system obtains an official score of 63.86 and ranks fourth in Track 1.

AI.tldr: 面向ISCSLP NVVSpeech挑战赛，提出以数据为中心的NVV感知ASR流水线：跨数据集标签对齐+两阶段采样（先平方根类别采样、后均匀类别微调），官方得分63.86，Track 1排名第四。
AI.motivation: 非言语发声（NVV）承载重要副语言信息，但常规ASR系统通常忽略它们；ISCSLP NVVSpeech挑战赛要求在有限且高度不平衡的监督下联合转写词汇内容与16类NVV，数据稀缺与长尾分布是主要难点。
AI.method: 以数据为中心的两项关键设计：(1) 跨数据集标签对齐——将异构来源标签映射到官方分类体系，并剔除无法可靠映射的样本；(2) 两阶段采样调度——先用平方根类别采样缓解长尾分布，再进行均匀类别微调。
AI.result: 在固定本地验证集上，平方根类别采样在所测试的单阶段设置中表现最佳；最终两阶段系统获得官方得分63.86，在Track 1中排名第四。
AI.conclusion: 标签对齐与两阶段采样调度可有效应对NVV-Aware ASR中的监督受限与类别不平衡问题，验证了以数据为中心策略在该任务上的有效性。

title: Perplexity Predicts Protection: Choosing Pretrained Backbones for Worst-Client Fairness in Federated Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
summary: Federated learning lets multiple parties train a shared model without pooling their data, but a client with far less data than the others can end up poorly served even when the group's average accuracy looks fine. We ask whether the choice of pretrained backbone affects this under LoRA fine-tuning, and whether per-word perplexity on the target text predicts which backbone helps the worst-off client before federated training starts. We ran 313 experiments across three text-classification datasets and three similarly sized backbones (RoBERTa, BERTweet, PubMedBERT), each compared against a task-specific baseline on identical data splits. Lower-perplexity backbones consistently produced larger gains for the worst-performing client, with a rank correlation of -0.87 across nine dataset-backbone pairs; a backbone held out of the analysis confirmed the pattern. Personalization with Ditto recovered only 4-12% of the gap between training alone and full federation, and removing aggregation entirely erased the benefit. A client's update also showed no sign of conflicting with the group's update; the two are close to orthogonal, ruling out one proposed explanation for this failure. Practically: measure perplexity on a sample of task text before choosing a backbone, and do not rely on personalization to protect a data-poor client. We release our code, predictions, and full results for others to test.

AI.tldr: 在LoRA微调的联邦学习中，预训练骨干在目标任务文本上的困惑度可预测其对数据贫乏客户端的助益（秩相关-0.87），而个性化（Ditto）仅弥补4-12%差距。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习虽避免汇聚原始数据，但当某客户端数据量远少于其他方时，即使群体平均准确率看似正常，该客户端仍可能被服务不周。作者追问两个问题：预训练骨干的选择在LoRA微调下是否影响这一现象；以及在联邦训练开始前，目标文本上的逐词困惑度能否预测哪个骨干对最差客户端更有帮助。
AI.method: 在3个文本分类数据集与3个体量相近的骨干（RoBERTa、BERTweet、PubMedBERT）上开展313次实验，各自与相同数据划分下的任务专用基线对比。以目标文本上的逐词困惑度作为骨干的事前指标，与最差客户端的性能增益做秩相关分析，并留出一个骨干验证模式。同时评估Ditto个性化方法以及去除聚合机制的效果，并检验客户端更新与群体更新的冲突假设。
AI.result: 困惑度更低的骨干持续为最差客户端带来更大增益，在9个数据集-骨干组合上秩相关为-0.87，留出的骨干也证实了这一模式。Ditto个性化仅弥补单独训练与完全联邦之间4-12%的差距；完全去除聚合则使收益消失。客户端更新与群体更新几乎正交，未显示冲突迹象，从而排除了一种被提出的失败解释。
AI.conclusion: 实践建议：选择骨干前先在一小段任务文本样本上测量困惑度，且不要依赖个性化来保护数据贫乏客户端。作者公开代码、预测与完整结果以供复现验证。

title: Propose, Verify, Commit: Evidence-Grounded Memory for Long-Horizon Multi-Actor Conversations
summary: Memory enables language model agents to use information beyond their context windows, but maintaining and accessing this information reliably remains difficult. Long-horizon conversational memory is especially challenging in multi-actor settings, where relevant evidence is distributed across participants and contexts, and previously established information may later be revised. We introduce EGMEMORY, a training-free agentic memory framework centered on evidence chains that preserve message-level evidence and provenance while tracking active states and their revision histories. At write time, adaptive memory inspection and an evidence-grounded propose-verify-commit protocol govern state updates. At read time, adaptive evidence navigation iteratively identifies the state and supporting evidence required for a query, using conversational structure to narrow the search space and lexical-semantic relevance to rank candidates. The system operates through prompting and tool use without memory-specific policy training. EGMEMORY achieves 68.2% on GroupMemBench and 77.9% on EverMemBench, outperforming the strongest evaluated baselines by 22.7 and 21.4 percentage points, respectively. It further reaches 73.6% on the dyadic LoCoMo benchmark, supporting its applicability beyond multi-actor conversations.

AI.tldr: EGMEMORY 是一个免训练的智能体记忆框架，以“证据链”为核心，在写入时用“提议-验证-提交”协议更新状态并保留修订历史，在读取时用自适应证据导航定位所需状态与证据；在 GroupMemBench 上达 68.2%、EverMemBench 上达 77.9%、LoCoMo 上达 73.6%。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体需要借助记忆使用超出上下文窗口的信息，但记忆的可靠维护与访问仍然困难。尤其在多参与者长程对话中，相关证据分散在不同参与者与上下文之间，且先前确立的信息可能被后续修订，这使得记忆管理更具挑战。
AI.method: 提出 EGMEMORY，一个免训练的智能体记忆框架。核心是证据链：保留消息级证据与来源（provenance），同时跟踪活跃状态及其修订历史。写入阶段采用自适应记忆检查与“基于证据的提议-验证-提交（propose-verify-commit）”协议来治理状态更新；读取阶段采用自适应证据导航，迭代地识别查询所需的状态与支撑证据，利用对话结构缩小搜索空间，并用词汇-语义相关性对候选排序。系统仅通过提示与工具调用运行，无需记忆相关的策略训练。
AI.result: 在 GroupMemBench 上达到 68.2%，在 EverMemBench 上达到 77.9%，分别比最强的评测基线高出 22.7 和 21.4 个百分点；在双人对话基准 LoCoMo 上达到 73.6%，表明其适用性不限于多参与者对话。
AI.conclusion: EGMEMORY 通过证据链与自适应读写的免训练设计，显著提升多参与者长程对话记忆的可靠性与检索效果，并具备向双人对话等更广泛场景迁移的能力。

title: RPMem: Learning Long-Term Recurrent Parametric Memory Across Sessions for LLM Agents
summary: Long-running LLM agents require memory that persists and evolves across sessions. Text-based memory retrieves and reconstructs past interactions at every query, making long-horizon performance increasingly dependent on retrieval quality and contextual reasoning as histories grow. Parametric memory encodes experience directly into model computation, but existing approaches provide limited support for cross-session memory evolution. Their coupling to a specific backbone further restricts memory reuse after model replacement. We introduce RPMem, a two-stage architecture that compiles each session into a model-independent latent memory through forward computation and selectively integrates it with retained memory via a task-trained recurrent gate. The consolidated memory is then mapped to backbone-specific low-rank adaptation (LoRA) parameters, allowing the encoding capability to transfer when the backbone is replaced. Evaluation across three long-term memory benchmarks and five diverse backbones demonstrates broad generalization with near-constant update cost and memory footprint. With Qwen3-8B on PERMA, RPMem reaches 85.52%, outperforming the strongest parametric and text-based baselines by 5.32 and 12.98 percentage points, respectively. Ablations validate the complementary roles of session compilation and cross-session consolidation, while dynamics analyses reveal that the gate acquires task-specific memory integration strategies. These results establish RPMem as a lifecycle-independent parametric memory framework that maintains evolving cross-session memory that remains reusable across backbone replacements. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Quark-Medical/rpmem/tree/main.

AI.tldr: RPMem 提出一种两阶段参数化记忆框架，将每次会话编译为与模型无关的潜在记忆，再映射为骨干特定的 LoRA 参数，实现跨会话演化与骨干替换下的记忆复用。
AI.motivation: 长期运行的 LLM 智能体需要跨会话持久且可演化的记忆。文本记忆依赖检索与上下文推理，随历史增长性能受检索质量制约；现有参数化记忆对跨会话演化支持有限，且与特定骨干耦合，模型替换后记忆难以复用。
AI.method: 两阶段架构：（1）通过前向计算将每个会话编译为与模型无关的潜在记忆，并借助任务训练的循环门控选择性地与保留记忆整合；（2）将整合后的记忆映射为骨干特定的 LoRA 参数，使编码能力在骨干替换后可迁移。
AI.result: 在三个长期记忆基准和五个骨干上验证，具有广泛泛化性，更新成本与内存占用近恒定。Qwen3-8B 在 PERMA 上达 85.52%，分别超越最强参数化与文本基线 5.32 和 12.98 个百分点。消融实验验证了会话编译与跨会话整合的互补作用；动态分析显示门控习得任务特定的记忆整合策略。
AI.conclusion: RPMem 是一种生命周期无关的参数化记忆框架，可维持不断演化的跨会话记忆，并在骨干替换后保持可复用性。

title: Can't Find Waldo: Evaluating VLMs' Sensitivity to Image Resolution and Detail Level
summary: Visual Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse tasks, yet they struggle with high-resolution inputs where critical information resides in small regions or detailed, cluttered scenes. While several approaches address this limitation, a systematic understanding of why models fail at high resolutions is lacking. We introduce a controlled evaluation framework that disentangles resolution-related performance degradation from task difficulty through semantics-preserving transformations. We propose two simple metrics: Area Under the Scaling Curve (AUSC), which quantifies scaling robustness independent of baseline accuracy, and Prediction Variance Score (PVS), which measures resolution-induced prediction instability. Through comprehensive experiments across 5 model families and 5 benchmarks, we identify three primary failure modes: (1) information loss from downsampling at vision token limits, (2) tokenization artifacts from patch boundary shifts and positional encoding fragility under non-standard aspect ratios, and (3) attention dilution as token counts increase. Our analysis reveals that even state-of-the-art models suffer from performance drops when processing high-resolution images, with degradation patterns varying systematically by architectural family. We provide actionable insights for model architecture design and data augmentation strategies to mitigate these limitations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个受控评估框架，通过语义保持变换解耦分辨率相关的性能退化与任务难度，并引入AUSC与PVS两个指标，系统揭示VLM在高分辨率输入下的三类主要失效模式。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在多种任务上表现优异，但在关键信息位于小区域或复杂细节场景的高分辨率输入上表现不佳。现有研究虽提出多种改进方法，却缺乏对模型在高分辨率下失败原因的系统性理解，因此需要一套可控的评估框架来厘清问题根源。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个受控评估框架，利用语义保持变换（semantics-preserving transformations）将分辨率导致的性能退化与任务本身难度解耦。并提出了两个简洁指标：面积缩放曲线下面积（AUSC），用于量化独立于基线精度的缩放鲁棒性；预测方差分数（PVS），用于衡量分辨率引起的预测不稳定性。实验覆盖5个模型家族与5个基准测试。
AI.result: 实验识别出三种主要失效模式：（1）视觉token上限下采样造成的信息损失；（2）非标准宽高比下patch边界偏移与位置编码脆弱性导致的token化伪影；（3）token数量增加带来的注意力稀释。分析显示，即便最先进的模型在处理高分辨率图像时也会出现性能下降，且退化模式按架构家族呈现系统性差异。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解VLM高分辨率失败机制提供了系统性框架与量化指标，并给出面向模型架构设计与数据增强策略的可操作建议，以缓解上述局限。

title: Algebraic Consistency Alone Does Not Certify Temporal Structure in Latent Action Models
summary: Latent action models infer a code for the transition between two frames of action-free video. Recent methods regularise this code to compose additively and reverse antisymmetrically, and report order-of-magnitude reductions in the resulting errors as a label-free certificate that the code has captured temporal structure. We show that this conclusion does not follow. Reconstruction drives the decoded transition toward a difference of state features, for which both identities hold for any pairing, a solution the metric cannot distinguish from one encoding nuisance state or a coordinate convention. Across five source domains, a trained but unconstrained counterpart already achieves 83-97% of the reduction relative to an untrained anchor. The residual fold is governed as much by the decoder family as by what is learned. A constrained model retrained after its temporal pairing is destroyed still reaches, in each domain, a lower error than the unconstrained model on real data. Downstream, preserving the temporal pairing yields no consistent advantage on LIBERO-GOAL or LIBERO-SPATIAL, and across the tested arms the code's mean linear action decodability falls as the algebraic error improves. We also test the most direct repair, a violation-contrastive objective that requires the algebra to fail on destroyed pairings: in the tested configurations it yields only a marginal separation within the reconstruction budget, on training and test triples alike. We recommend a validation protocol that these methods currently lack: a baseline-corrected metric, retraining on destroyed pairings, and a seed-budget analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文对潜动作模型（Latent Action Models）中基于代数正则（加性组合与反对称反转）的评估指标提出质疑，论证该指标无法证明所学编码真正捕获了时序结构，并给出改进的验证协议。
AI.motivation: 近期方法通过正则化使潜动作编码满足加性可组合与反对称反转，并据此报告误差数量级的下降，将其作为"无标签证据"说明编码捕获了时序结构。作者认为这一推论不成立，需要审视该指标是否真正具有区分能力。
AI.method: 从理论与实验两方面进行分析：论证重建目标会驱使解码出的转移趋向状态特征之差，而这一解对任意配对都满足上述两条代数恒等式；在五个源域上比较受约束模型与不受约束模型（相对未训练锚点的误差下降比例）；用解码器家族消融检验残差来源；将受约束模型在时序配对被破坏后重新训练并对比误差；在 LIBERO-GOAL 与 LIBERO-SPATIAL 上测试下游表现；并考察一种违规对比（violation-contrastive）目标这一最直接补救方案。
AI.result: 未受约束的对照模型已达到相对未训练锚点 83-97% 的误差下降；受约束模型在时序配对被破坏后重训，在各域真实数据上误差仍低于未受约束模型；残差折叠既受所学内容影响，也受解码器家族影响；下游任务中保留时序配对无一致优势，且随代数误差改善，编码的平均线性动作可解码性反而下降；违规对比目标在测试配置下仅带来重建预算内的边际区分度。
AI.conclusion: 现有代数误差指标无法作为编码捕获时序结构的有效证据，因为其可被任意配对满足，且可被未受约束模型与解码器选择复现。作者建议采用这些方法目前缺失的验证协议：基线校正指标、在破坏配对上重新训练、以及种子预算分析。

title: Cognitive Action Reasoning for Proactive Robots from Human-Centered Multimodal Observations
summary: Robots operating in human-centered environments are typically designed to execute explicit instructions, and most robot-learning datasets likewise pair observations with task instructions or low-level actions. Although recent work has begun to explore proactive embodied assistance, existing resources target different settings and action levels, leaving real-world human-centered multimodal decision-making underexplored. We formulate this problem as \textit{Proactive Robot Action Reasoning} (\textit{ProRobo}), an upstream cognitive decision problem in which a robot must determine which action to take based on multimodal human and environmental cues without explicit action instructions. To support ProRobo, we introduce \textit{ProAction}, a real-world multimodal dataset containing 10K samples of visual observations, audio signals, and text inputs across 12 daily-life scenarios in five common scenes. To construct cognitively grounded high-level action supervision, we develop a two-stage human-in-the-loop pipeline that combines appraisal-guided candidate generation with Affective Theory-of-Mind-guided human refinement, explicitly incorporating contextual judgment about human states, urgency, feasibility, and potential risk into action annotation. Based on this supervision, we benchmark representative Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and introduce \textit{MMC2Act}, a reference model that implicitly learns the mapping from multimodal observations to cognitively grounded high-level actions. Experiments across modality settings, subject-disjoint generalization, cross-dataset transfer, and human evaluation show that general-purpose MLLMs struggle with proactively reasoning high-level actions from multimodal cues, whereas training on \textit{ProAction} substantially improves performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出主动式机器人动作推理（ProRobo）任务及ProAction真实多模态数据集，并构建参考模型MMC2Act，证明通用MLLM在该任务上表现不足，而基于该数据训练可显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人及数据集多以显式指令或低层动作为目标，虽已有主动式具身辅助研究，但针对真实人类中心场景的多模态高层决策仍缺乏资源，难以支撑机器人在无显式指令下主动判断该采取何种行动。
AI.method: 形式上定义ProRobo为上游认知决策问题；构建ProAction数据集，包含5类场景、12种日常生活情境下的1万条视觉、音频与文本多模态样本；采用两阶段人在回路标注流程，结合评价引导的候选生成与情感心智理论引导的人工精修，纳入对人类状态、紧迫性、可行性和潜在风险的上下文判断；据此对代表性MLLM进行基准测试，并提出隐式学习多模态观测到认知层高层动作映射的参考模型MMC2Act。
AI.result: 在多模态设置、主体不相交泛化、跨数据集迁移及人工评估等实验中，通用MLLM难以从多模态线索主动推理高层动作，而在ProAction上训练可大幅提升性能。
AI.conclusion: ProAction与MMC2Act为人类中心场景下的主动式具身决策提供了数据与模型基础，表明认知层监督对主动机器人动作推理至关重要。

title: BabelArena: A Large-Scale Multilingual Benchmark for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute multi-step workflows through tool use and interaction with users and environments. However, current agent evaluations are largely English-centric, limiting our understanding of agent capabilities in multilingual settings. We introduce BabelFlow, a benchmark-general agentic workflow that adapts existing agent benchmarks to new languages by analyzing runtime dependencies, coordinating structure-preserving translation, and combining multi-layer verification with human review to preserve task and evaluation semantics. Using BabelFlow, we construct BabelArena, a task-aligned benchmark comprising 16,146 instances derived from 702 canonical tasks across four benchmark families, 13 domains, and 23 languages. Experiments with five frontier models show that no single model dominates across benchmark families and that cross-language disparities extend well beyond task success. Lower-resource languages exhibit distinct failure patterns, with larger shares of tool-use and control-flow errors rather than answer-quality errors alone, pointing to gaps in reliable task execution across the resource levels of these languages. On the same tasks, agents in low-resource languages also consume substantially more tokens than in English (up to roughly twice the input) without proportional increases in interaction length, and language consistency degrades further on tasks requiring structured output, where switches are directed overwhelmingly toward English. We believe BabelArena provides a foundation for advancing research on reliable and efficient multilingual agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BabelFlow（跨语言智能体工作流基准构建方法）并构建 BabelArena（23 种语言、16,146 条实例的多语言智能体基准），揭示前沿模型在跨语言任务执行中的性能、错误模式与效率差异。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体评测以英语为中心，无法反映多语言环境下的智能体能力，也缺乏可迁移到新语言的标准化评测流程。
AI.method: 提出 BabelFlow：分析原基准的运行时依赖，进行保持结构不变的多语言翻译，并结合多层自动验证与人工审核以保留任务语义与评测语义；据此从 4 个基准族、13 个领域、702 个规范任务构建 BabelArena，共 16,146 条实例。
AI.result: 五个前沿模型均无跨基准族的全面优势；跨语言差异不仅体现在任务成功率，低资源语言呈现更多工具使用与控制流错误而非仅答案质量错误；同一任务下低资源语言 token 消耗显著更高（输入最高约为英语的两倍），而交互轮数并未成比例增加；需结构化输出的任务中语言一致性进一步下降，切换方向绝大多数指向英语。
AI.conclusion: BabelArena 为可靠、高效的多语言智能体研究提供了可扩展的评测基础。

title: CE$^4$L: Continual Ego, Exo, and Ego-Exo Learning
summary: Perception for embodied agents is video-based, often multi-view (ego, exo, or both), and inherently continual, with simultaneous task and viewpoint shifts. Yet continual learning (CL) remains dominated by exo-only recognition tasks, obscuring behavior under these real-world coupled shifts. We introduce Continual Ego, E}xo, and Ego-Exo Learning (CE$^4$L), a unified multi-view CL benchmark spanning four representative tasks: cross-view referenced skill assessment, temporal action segmentation, cross-view association, and action anticipation & planning. CE$^4$L highlights challenges largely absent in prior CL benchmarks, including cross-view correspondence, view-dependent asynchrony, and heterogeneous semantic objectives. To this end, we propose Video Incremental Subspace-routed Task Adapters (VISTA), a parameter-efficient baseline method that stores task-specific updates in lightweight adapters and performs training-free routing via residual distance to task-specific whitened subspaces estimated from second-order statistics. Extensive experiments demonstrate the significantly varied efficacy of representative CL methods across CE$^4$L settings, while VISTA is consistently competitive and achieves state-of-the-art overall performance. Our source code for benchmarks and methods is available at https://github.com/AnAppleCore/CE4L .

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了CE$^4$L——一个统一的多视角持续学习基准（涵盖自我中心、外部视角及二者结合），包含四项任务（跨视角参考技能评估、时序动作分割、跨视角关联、动作预测与规划），并提出了VISTA（视频增量子空间路由任务适配器）这一参数高效基线方法，在多任务上取得一致的领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现实中的具身智能体感知是基于视频的、往往多视角（自我中心、外部视角或二者兼有），且本质上是持续学习的，任务与视角会同时发生漂移。然而现有持续学习研究主要局限于仅外部视角的识别任务，掩盖了在这种真实耦合漂移下的行为表现。因此需要一个能反映多视角、任务与视角耦合漂移的持续学习基准。
AI.method: 论文构建了CE$^4$L基准，统一涵盖自我中心、外部视角及自我-外部视角，覆盖四项代表性任务：跨视角参考技能评估、时序动作分割、跨视角关联、动作预测与规划，并突出跨视角对应、视角依赖的异步性、异构语义目标等新挑战。同时提出VISTA方法：将任务特定更新存储于轻量级适配器中，并基于从二阶统计量估计的任务特定白化子空间的残差距离进行免训练路由。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，代表性持续学习方法在CE$^4$L的不同设定下效果差异显著，而VISTA始终保持竞争力，并取得整体最优的SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 持续学习需要面向多视角、任务与视角耦合漂移的真实具身感知场景；CE$^4$L为该方向提供了统一基准，VISTA作为参数高效的基线方法表现稳定且优越。基准与方法源码已开源。

title: Pay More Attention To Text In High-Resolution MLLMs
summary: Failures of high-resolution MLLMs are commonly attributed to a visual problem, motivating zooming, cropping, and related visual interventions to recover fine-grained evidence or suppress interference. Yet recent studies suggest that relevant visual evidence is already encoded in intermediate representations, indicating that visual-side improvements alone insufficient. This raises a natural question: does the remaining bottleneck lie in the text that guides visual search? We identify a previously overlooked linguistic bottleneck: questions formulated for answering do not necessarily specify the visual evidence required for localization. To address this mismatch, we introduce EviSpec, a training-free compiler that derives complementary evidence specifications while preserving the original question for final reasoning. We further validate it through matched-control experiments that isolate the roles of evidence specification and localization. With the search budget fixed, structured evidence specifications yield an 8.6% relative gain over generic requests. With evidence geometry matched, the evidence localized by EviSpec yields a 14.8% relative gain over random evidence. Together, these controls isolate the benefit of specifying what evidence to seek rather than merely expanding visual access. Across all five MLLMs, EviSpec consistently improves upon the corresponding baseline on each of the three benchmarks, yielding average relative gains of \textbf{10.4%, 8.8%, and 12.4%} on V\textsuperscript{*}Bench, HR-Bench-4K, and HR-Bench-8K, respectively. Beyond high-resolution reasoning, EviSpec also achieves state-of-the-art performance on VQA and hallucination-focused benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文识别出多模态大模型高分辨率推理中一个被忽视的语言瓶颈：面向回答的问题未明确指定定位所需的视觉证据，并提出免训练的证据规范编译器EviSpec。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率MLLM的失败常被归因于视觉问题，因而催生缩放、裁剪等视觉干预。但近期研究表明相关视觉证据已编码在中间表示中，说明仅靠视觉侧改进不足，瓶颈可能在于引导视觉搜索的文本问题本身。
AI.method: 提出免训练的编译器EviSpec，在保留原始问题用于最终推理的同时，派生互补的证据规范（evidence specification）；并通过匹配控制实验，分别隔离"证据规范"与"定位"两个因素的作用。
AI.result: 在固定搜索预算下，结构化证据规范比通用请求获得8.6%相对增益；在匹配证据几何条件下，EviSpec定位的证据比随机证据获得14.8%相对增益。在全部五个MLLM上，EviSpec在三个基准上均优于对应基线，在V*Bench、HR-Bench-4K、HR-Bench-8K上平均相对增益分别为10.4%、8.8%、12.4%；在VQA和幻觉相关基准上也达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 瓶颈在于"指定应寻找何种证据"而非单纯扩大视觉访问范围；明确证据规范可显著提升高分辨率推理，并泛化到VQA与幻觉任务。

title: Detecting Phone-Induced Pedestrian Distraction via a Multimodal Fusion Transformer
comment: 2026 IEEE 9th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT 2026)
summary: The increasing reliance on mobile phones has made phone-induced pedestrian distraction increasingly prevalent. Activities such as texting, watching videos, and making phone calls have become significant contributors to traffic accidents. Reliable detection of pedestrian distraction is essential for autonomous vehicles, as it improves situational awareness and enables timely risk assessment, thereby supporting safe motion planning and vehicle control. We propose a multimodal fusion Transformer (MFT) for detecting phone-induced pedestrian distraction. MFT jointly extracts skeletal dynamics from body pose keypoints and visual appearance features from pedestrian images, effectively leveraging the complementary information provided by the two modalities. A cross-modal attention module is proposed to capture inter-modal dependencies through multi-head cross-attention, facilitating effective fusion of complementary information across the two modalities. Then, a temporal attention fusion module, implemented with a Transformer encoder, is employed to capture temporal dependencies. MFT is trained and evaluated on a manually annotated dataset comprising 287 pedestrian instances with 20,741 images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MFT attains an overall accuracy of 95%, exceeding the performance of six baseline approaches by 6%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多模态融合Transformer（MFT），联合利用人体姿态骨骼动态与视觉外观特征，通过跨模态注意力和时序注意力融合模块检测手机引发的行人分心，在自建数据集上达到95%准确率，高出六个基线方法6%。
AI.motivation: 手机使用导致行人分心现象日益普遍，发短信、看视频、打电话等行为成为交通事故的重要诱因。自动驾驶车辆需要可靠的行人分心检测以提升态势感知、及时进行风险评估，从而支持安全的运动规划与车辆控制。
AI.method: 提出多模态融合Transformer（MFT）。一方面从人体姿态关键点中提取骨骼动态特征，另一方面从行人图像中提取视觉外观特征，实现两模态互补信息的联合利用；设计跨模态注意力模块，通过多头交叉注意力捕获模态间依赖关系以有效融合互补信息；随后采用基于Transformer编码器的时序注意力融合模块捕获时序依赖。
AI.result: 在人工标注的数据集（287个行人实例、20,741张图像）上训练与评估。大量实验表明，MFT整体准确率达95%，较六个基线方法高出6%。
AI.conclusion: MFT通过骨骼动态与视觉外观的双模态互补融合，结合跨模态与时序注意力机制，可有效且可靠地检测手机引发的行人分心行为，性能优于现有基线方法，具备支持自动驾驶安全决策的潜力。

title: GARO: Geometry-Aware Redundancy Optimization for Real-Time and High-Fidelity Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
summary: Novel view synthesis is a key task for dynamic scene reconstruction, where high rendering speed is essential for applications such as virtual reality. Existing deformable Gaussian Splatting methods achieve high-fidelity dynamic scene modeling, but still face limitations in memory usage and rendering efficiency due to the large number of redundant Gaussians. To address these challenges, we propose Geometry-Aware Redundancy Optimization (GARO), a unified redundancy measurement framework in the adaptive density control stage of the traditional dynamic scene reconstruction pipeline. This framework first selects low-gradient candidates using an optimization activity assessment strategy, and then evaluates geometric complexity through low curvature analysis to further filter and prune redundant points, resulting in a compact and expressive Gaussian representation. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that GARO achieves robust trade-offs between quality and speed, with PSNR remaining stable and rendering speed improved by 2x, validating the efficiency and effectiveness of GARO.

AI.tldr: 提出GARO框架，通过低梯度筛选与低曲率几何复杂度分析剔除冗余高斯点，实现动态场景重建中渲染速度2倍提升且PSNR保持稳定。
AI.motivation: 动态场景的新视角合成对虚拟现实等应用至关重要，需要高渲染速度。现有的可变形高斯泼溅方法虽能高保真建模动态场景，但因存在大量冗余高斯点，在内存占用和渲染效率上仍受限。
AI.method: 提出几何感知冗余优化（GARO），在传统动态场景重建流程的自适应密度控制阶段构建统一的冗余度量框架：首先通过优化活跃度评估策略筛选低梯度候选点，再借助低曲率分析评估几何复杂度，进一步过滤与剪枝冗余点，从而获得紧凑且具表现力的高斯表示。
AI.result: 在合成与真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，GARO在质量与速度之间实现了稳健权衡：PSNR保持稳定，渲染速度提升2倍。
AI.conclusion: GARO验证了其在冗余优化方面的有效性与高效性，为动态场景重建提供了一种兼顾质量与速度的紧凑高斯表示方案。

title: GeoBalance: Geometry-Aware Monitoring and Reconstruction with Asymmetric Optimization for Balanced Multimodal Learning
summary: Multimodal classifiers can converge to modality-dominant solutions in which one modality dominates the joint prediction, suppressing the learning of others. Existing balancing methods mainly adjust losses, gradients, or modality contributions, largely treating modality imbalance as an optimization problem while implicitly treating the weak modality as under-optimized but representationally intact. In this work, we find that this assumption does not always hold, as persistent modality dominance can induce a representation-level collapse of the weak modality, which we term \emph{manifold modality collapse} (MMC). MMC manifests as a coupled geometric degradation in which weak-modality representations collapse onto fewer directions within each class and become less separable across classes. Motivated by this observation, we propose \emph{GeoBalance}, a geometry-aware framework that monitors these two geometric properties and reconstructs the weak modality representation only when it exhibits signs of MMC. Once triggered, GeoBalance uses a fixed Simplex-ETF class scaffold and spectral regularization to restore class separation while preventing collapse onto a few feature directions. To preserve reconstruction during joint training, asymmetric gradient projection removes the joint-gradient component conflicting with reconstruction, leaving non-conflicting optimization unchanged. Extensive experiments across six multimodal benchmarks demonstrate great improvements over competitive balancing methods, validating its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多模态训练中的模态主导会导致弱模态表征坍缩（MMC），并提出几何感知框架 GeoBalance 在检测到坍缩时重构弱模态表征。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态平衡方法主要调整损失、梯度或模态贡献，将模态不平衡视为优化问题，并隐含假设弱模态只是优化不足而表征完好。作者发现该假设并不总成立：持续的模态主导会导致弱模态出现表征级坍缩（MMC）。
AI.method: 提出 GeoBalance 几何感知框架：监测弱模态的两类几何属性（类内方向数、类间可分性），仅在出现 MMC 迹象时触发弱模态表征重构；使用固定的 Simplex-ETF 类支架与谱正则化恢复类间可分性并防止坍缩到少数特征方向；采用非对称梯度投影去除与重构冲突的联合梯度分量，保持非冲突优化不变。
AI.result: 在六个多模态基准上进行了大量实验，相比竞争性平衡方法取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 模态不平衡不仅是优化问题，还涉及弱模态的表征几何退化；通过几何监测与按需重构可有效缓解 MMC，验证了该框架的有效性。

title: PosEviLoc: Position-Conditioned Spatial Evidence for Language-Based 3D Localization
summary: Language-based 3D localization retrieves the point-cloud submap containing a target position from descriptions of nearby objects and their spatial relations. Existing methods typically compress queries and submaps into global descriptors, potentially obscuring object-level semantics and cross-description spatial coherence. We propose Position-Conditioned Evidence Localization (PosEviLoc), a query-position-aware framework for coarse text-to-point-cloud localization. Instead of relying on global matching, PosEviLoc evaluates each candidate submap using explicit semantic and spatial evidence. It models direction as a relation jointly determined by an object position and a hypothetical query position. The resulting Query-Position Spatial Evidence Field (QSEF) measures the fraction of query descriptions supported at each hypothetical position, explicitly capturing their agreement without using the ground-truth query pose to construct the evidence field. A Multi-Level Evidence Readout (MER) summarizes this evidence in a compact representation, which a lightweight MLP converts into a retrieval score. Across five benchmarks, PosEviLoc outperforms MNCL by an average of 17 percentage points in Recall@1. When used as a plug-and-play reranker, it improves MNCL by an average of 16 percentage points. Moreover, PosEviLoc introduces substantially fewer parameters and achieves faster inference speed than existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 PosEviLoc 框架，通过显式语义与空间证据实现查询位置感知的文本到点云粗定位，在五个基准上平均提升 MNCL 17 个百分点的 Recall@1，并可即插即用地重排序。
AI.motivation: 现有语言驱动的 3D 定位方法通常将查询与子图压缩为全局描述子，容易掩盖对象级语义以及跨描述的空间一致性。作者希望避免全局匹配带来的信息损失，转而基于候选子图逐一评估显式的语义与空间证据。
AI.method: PosEviLoc 将方向建模为由对象位置与假设查询位置共同决定的关系；构建 Query-Position Spatial Evidence Field（QSEF），度量每个假设位置上查询描述被支持的比例，且不使用真值查询位姿来构造证据场；再用 Multi-Level Evidence Readout（MER）汇总证据为紧凑表示，由轻量 MLP 转换为检索分数。该方法可在不依赖全局匹配的情况下进行查询位置感知的粗定位，并可作重排序模块。
AI.result: 在五个基准上，PosEviLoc 相比 MNCL 的 Recall@1 平均提升 17 个百分点；作为即插即用重排序器时，平均提升 MNCL 16 个百分点；同时参数量显著更少，推理速度更快。
AI.conclusion: 显式的语义与空间证据评估优于全局描述子匹配，能在更少参数和更快推理下显著提升文本到点云粗定位性能，并具备良好的即插即用重排序能力。

title: Towards robust multimodal 3D object detection via visual foundation models
comment: 27 pages, 5 figures. Bilingual English-Chinese manuscript; the complete English version appears first, followed by the complete Chinese version
summary: Multimodal 3D object detection is fundamental to robust perception in autonomous driving because it integrates complementary information from LiDAR and camera sensors. However, existing methods often fail to maintain robustness under out-of-distribution (OOD) corruptions caused by sensor noise, adverse weather, and environmental changes. To address this problem, we propose RoboDistill, a robust and generalizable multimodal 3D object detection framework that leverages visual foundation models (VFMs), such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM). First, we introduce SAM-AD, a domain-specific pretraining strategy that fine-tunes SAM on autonomous-driving imagery to extract feature representations with rich semantic information. Second, we design the AD Feature Pyramid Network (AD-FPN) to refine and upsample SAM features at multiple scales for seamless fusion with LiDAR features. Third, we develop the Depth-Guided Wavelet Attention (DGWA) module, which suppresses high-frequency sensor noise while preserving critical contextual information. Finally, we introduce KD Fusion, in which the pretrained SAM-AD serves as a teacher that distills high-quality visual knowledge into a lightweight point-cloud network, thereby improving robustness under noisy conditions. Extensive experiments across 27 challenging OOD corruption settings show that RoboDistill generally delivers stronger or competitive detection performance and robustness relative to representative state-of-the-art methods. This work bridges the gap between VFMs and 3D object detection and advances robust multimodal perception for real-world autonomous-driving applications.

AI.tldr: 提出RoboDistill框架，利用视觉基础模型（如SAM）提升多模态3D目标检测在OOD损坏下的鲁棒性与泛化性，包含SAM-AD预训练、AD-FPN、DGWA与KD Fusion四个组件。
AI.motivation: 多模态3D目标检测融合LiDAR与相机信息，是自动驾驶鲁棒感知的基础，但现有方法在传感器噪声、恶劣天气和环境变化导致的分布外（OOD）损坏下鲁棒性不足。因此需要借助视觉基础模型的丰富语义表征来弥补这一差距。
AI.method: 提出RoboDistill框架，含四个组件：（1）SAM-AD：在自动驾驶图像上微调SAM的领域特定预训练策略，提取富含语义的特征；（2）AD-FPN：多尺度精炼并上采样SAM特征，实现与LiDAR特征的无缝融合；（3）DGWA（深度引导小波注意力）：抑制高频传感器噪声同时保留关键上下文信息；（4）KD Fusion：以预训练SAM-AD为教师，将高质量视觉知识蒸馏到轻量级点云网络，提升噪声下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在27种具有挑战性的OOD损坏设置下进行大量实验，RoboDistill相对代表性SOTA方法普遍取得更强或具竞争力的检测性能与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥合了视觉基础模型与3D目标检测之间的差距，推动了面向真实自动驾驶应用的鲁棒多模态感知发展。

title: SewFusion: Tailored Generation of Topology and Panel-Level Geometry for Sewing Patterns
summary: Generating sewing patterns from images and text requires modeling a heterogeneous representation composed of discrete topology and continuous geometry. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: diffusion-based methods enable holistic geometry generation by converting the entire pattern into a continuous representation, but weaken discrete topology modeling; in contrast, autoregressive methods preserve discrete topology through next-token prediction, but tie continuous geometry regression to token-level hidden states with limited panel-level context. To bridge this gap, we propose SewFusion, a unified autoregressive framework that adopts tailored generation mechanisms for discrete topology and panel-level continuous geometry, using next-token prediction for the former and flow matching for the latter. To support panel-level continuous geometry generation, we introduce a Panel Geometry VAE that learns a fixed-size latent space for variable-length panel geometry, together with Panel Geometry Flow for latent generation. We further propose Panel-Forcing to reduce the training--inference mismatch in topology context and improve robustness to topology prediction errors. Extensive experiments on SewFactory and GCD-MM demonstrate that SewFusion consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods across various settings, achieving +6.36% Panel Accuracy, +11.30% Stitch Accuracy, and -1.90 Vertex L2 error in the image-text-based generation setting.

AI.tldr: SewFusion 是一个统一的自回归框架，将离散拓扑与面板级连续几何分别建模，用下一词元预测生成拓扑，用流匹配生成几何，并引入 Panel Geometry VAE、Panel Geometry Flow 与 Panel-Forcing，实现了从图像和文本生成缝纫纸样的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 从图像和文本生成缝纫纸样需要同时建模由离散拓扑与连续几何构成的异构表示。现有方法分为两类：基于扩散的方法把整个纸样转成连续表示，能做整体几何生成，但弱化了离散拓扑建模；自回归方法通过下一词元预测保留离散拓扑，却把连续几何回归绑定在词元级隐状态上，面板级上下文有限。两类范式各有权衡，难以兼顾拓扑与几何，因此需要一种能同时适配两种表征的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出 SewFusion，一个统一的自回归框架，对离散拓扑和面板级连续几何采用定制生成机制：前者用下一词元预测，后者用流匹配。为支持面板级连续几何生成，引入 Panel Geometry VAE，为变长面板几何学习固定大小的隐空间，并配合 Panel Geometry Flow 进行隐空间生成。此外提出 Panel-Forcing，以缓解拓扑上下文中的训练—推理不匹配，并提升对拓扑预测错误的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在 SewFactory 和 GCD-MM 上的大量实验表明，SewFusion 在多种设置下持续优于此前的最先进方法；在基于图像—文本的生成设置中，取得 +6.36% 的 Panel Accuracy、+11.30% 的 Stitch Accuracy，并将 Vertex L2 误差降低 1.90。
AI.conclusion: SewFusion 通过为离散拓扑与连续几何分别设计生成机制，弥合了扩散式与自回归式范式之间的差距，验证了面板级几何建模与 Panel-Forcing 的有效性，为图像—文本驱动的缝纫纸样生成提供了新的统一方案。

title: Paragraph Boundaries Are Not White Space:Compression Depth as the Signature of Hierarchical Structure
summary: Standard positional encodings treat position as a one-dimensional reading-order coordinate, but reading order alone does not determine hierarchical textual structure. We use a hierarchical rotary positional encoding (hRoPE) that represents paragraph, sentence, and token indices as separate channels, hold the token sequence fixed, intervene on the paragraph coordinate $p_1$, and measure cross-paragraph attention with a token-distance-exact estimator. Attention is compressed in every corpus, but compression alone is not diagnostic of true structure: an architecturally identical channel with density-matched random labels is compressed too. What distinguishes real structure is the depth of compression: the real-versus-random depth gap is resolvable in two of three corpora and not in the third, and real-structure depth varies more strongly across corpora than the control's. Comparing eight corpus-only quantities across three constructs (lexical persistence, paragraph length, embedding-based coherence), none fully reproduces the cross-corpus ordering of depth, though embedding-based coherence comes closest. At the paragraph level that relation transfers as a common slope, but with the opposite sign to the corpus-level ranking: controlling for length, diversity, and position, paragraphs with more similar neighbors compress less deeply, with no detectable slope difference between any pair of corpora, while length, lexical-diversity, and position effects remain corpus-specific. Compression depth, not its location, is the reproducible signature of genuine paragraph structure in our setting.

AI.tldr: 用层级旋转位置编码（hRoPE）将段落/句子/词元索引分离为独立通道，干预段落坐标并测量跨段注意力，发现真实层级结构比密度匹配的随机标签结构压缩更深；压缩深度而非位置才是真实段落结构的可复现标志。
AI.motivation: 标准位置编码把位置当作一维阅读顺序坐标，但阅读顺序无法刻画层级化的文本结构。作者希望检验"注意力压缩"是否能作为真实层级（段落）结构的诊断信号，并区分真结构与仅密度匹配的随机对照。
AI.method: 采用层级旋转位置编码（hRoPE），将段落、句子、词元索引表示为独立通道；固定词元序列，仅对段落坐标 p1 做干预，并用词元距离精确估计量测量跨段注意力。设置架构相同、密度匹配的随机标签通道作为对照，比较真实与随机的压缩深度，并将八种仅基于语料的量与三种构念（词汇持续性、段落长度、基于嵌入的连贯性）的跨语料排序进行对照。
AI.result: 所有语料中注意力均被压缩，但压缩本身不具诊断性，因为密度匹配的随机标签通道同样被压缩。真正区分结构的是压缩深度：真实与随机的深度差在三个语料中的两个可分辨、第三个不可分辨；真实结构的深度跨语料差异比对照更大。八种语料量中无一能完全复现深度的跨语料排序，基于嵌入的连贯性最接近。段落层面该关系以共同斜率迁移，但符号与语料级排序相反：控制长度、多样性与位置后，邻居更相似的段落压缩更浅，且任意两语料间斜率无显著差异，而长度、词汇多样性与位置效应仍具语料特异性。
AI.conclusion: 在本设定下，压缩深度而非压缩位置，才是真实段落结构的可复现标志；随机密度匹配对照说明单纯压缩不足以证明结构真实性。层级结构与连贯性的关系在段落层面表现为跨语料共享斜率，但方向与语料级排序相反，提示不同分析层级上结构—连贯性关系的复杂性。

title: Modeling Clinical Workflow for SYNTAX Scoring from Coronary Angiography Videos
summary: The SYNTAX score is a clinically established tool for assessing anatomical lesion complexity in coronary artery disease and guiding subsequent treatment. However, automated SYNTAX scoring is commonly formulated as a direct regression problem from coronary angiography videos to patient-level scores. In this work, we reformulate SYNTAX scoring as a vessel segment identity-preserving anatomical reasoning problem and propose a hierarchical modeling framework that explicitly aligns learning with the clinical workflow. Our approach maintains vessel segment identity across frames and views, estimates stenosis severity at the segment level, and aggregates evidence hierarchically according to coronary anatomy. Simultaneously, to address the scarcity of domain-specific data, we integrate and complete multiple public coronary angiography datasets, constructing a large-scale resource featuring completed vessel segmentation and derived structural annotations. Experiments demonstrate that vessel segment-level stenosis embedding enhances explanatory power and reduces prediction variability compared to baseline models, with the R^2 score improving by 0.201 and dev STD decreasing by 18.4%. These results highlight the necessity of structure-aligned modeling for reliable and stable automated SYNTAX scoring from multi-view coronary angiography videos. The GitHub link is https://github.com/VersaceSu7/SYNTAX_score_777.

AI.tldr: 本文将SYNTAX评分重新定义为血管节段身份保持的解剖推理问题，提出分层建模框架，并构建大规模冠脉造影数据集，实验显示R²提升0.201、标准差下降18.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化SYNTAX评分通常被建模为从冠脉造影视频到患者级分数的直接回归，忽略了临床工作流中的解剖结构与血管节段身份信息，导致解释性差、预测不稳定；同时领域专用数据稀缺。
AI.method: 将SYNTAX评分重构为血管节段身份保持的解剖推理问题，提出与临床流程显式对齐的分层建模框架：跨帧、跨视图保持血管节段身份，在节段层面估计狭窄严重程度，并依据冠脉解剖结构分层聚合证据；同时整合并补全多个公开冠脉造影数据集，构建具备完整血管分割与衍生结构标注的大规模资源。
AI.result: 相比基线模型，血管节段级狭窄嵌入提升了可解释性并降低预测变异性：R²提升0.201，预测标准差（std）下降18.4%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，对于从多视图冠脉造影视频进行可靠、稳定的自动化SYNTAX评分而言，结构对齐建模是必要的。

title: Local Predictability and Collective Fidelity in LLM-Agent Societies
comment: 35 pages, 7 figures. Standalone empirical companion to arXiv:2608.11215
summary: Compact surrogates could reduce the cost of simulating large language model societies, but must reproduce collective behavior. We compare individual predictions and collective forecasts using 9,455 published trajectories and new experiments on opinion dynamics. Neighbor information improves individual prediction in all 16 public-data settings and pooled collective forecasts on held-out questions, although collective gains depend on transfer conditions. Tests on 24 new statements do not confirm earlier contrasting history effects in forecasts from the initial state. Qwen benefits from history after three observed rounds. These findings motivate direct collective validation, explicit limits on available observations, and comparisons with simple baselines.

AI.tldr: 紧凑代理可降低大模型社会模拟成本，但需复现集体行为；本文通过9,455条轨迹与意见动力学实验比较个体预测与集体预测，并检验邻居信息、历史效应与迁移条件。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型社会模拟成本高昂，紧凑代理虽可降本，但必须验证其能否复现集体行为；同时已有关于历史效应等结论需在更多数据与实验条件下检验。
AI.method: 使用9,455条已发表轨迹，并在意见动力学上开展新实验；比较个体预测与集体预测，评估邻居信息在16个公开数据设置及留出问题上的作用，并在24条新陈述上检验初始状态预测中的历史效应及Qwen在观察三轮后的表现。
AI.result: 邻居信息在全部16个公开数据设置中改善个体预测，并在留出问题上改善汇总集体预测，但集体收益依赖迁移条件；24条新陈述未确认此前从初始状态预测中的对比性历史效应；Qwen在观察三轮后受益于历史。
AI.conclusion: 应开展直接的集体验证，明确限制可用观测，并与简单基线进行比较，以更可靠地评估紧凑代理的社会模拟能力。

title: Resolution-Flexible Decoding for Hybrid Neural Video Representations
summary: Neural video representations (NVRs) represent videos using neural network parameters and, in hybrid formulations, frame-wise latent embeddings. Although hybrid NVRs can improve reconstruction quality by using content-adaptive latent embeddings, their latent spatial sizes and decoder upsampling schedules are tied to the target frame resolution. For high-resolution videos, this dependency may require large and non-uniform upsampling factors and can affect the parameter allocation between the latent embeddings and the decoder. In this paper, we propose a resolution-flexible decoder framework for hybrid NVRs. The decoder is constructed from uniform \(2\times\) upsampling stages, whose target feature sizes are obtained by tracing the spatial resolution backward from the final output resolution. After each upsampling stage, the feature map is aligned with the target size by minimal padding or cropping when necessary. To support this progressive decoding process, we further use intermediate reconstruction supervision and a reconstruction-difficulty-aware frame sampling strategy based on recent frame-wise losses. The framework preserves the basic representation format of hybrid NVRs and can therefore be applied to different backbones. Experiments on the UVG dataset show that the proposed approach improves reconstruction quality over the corresponding NVR baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种分辨率灵活的解码器框架，用统一2倍上采样阶段和最小填充/裁剪对齐特征尺寸，并辅以中间重建监督和重建难度感知帧采样，提升混合神经视频表示的重建质量。
AI.motivation: 混合式神经视频表示（NVR）通过内容自适应隐嵌入提升重建质量，但其隐空间尺寸与解码器上采样计划绑定于目标帧分辨率。对高分辨率视频，这种依赖需要大且不均匀的上采样因子，并影响隐嵌入与解码器之间的参数分配。
AI.method: 框架采用由统一2×上采样阶段构成的分辨率灵活解码器；目标特征尺寸通过从最终输出分辨率反向推导空间分辨率获得。每个上采样阶段后，必要时用最小填充或裁剪将特征图与目标尺寸对齐。为支持该渐进式解码过程，进一步引入中间重建监督，以及基于近期逐帧损失的重建难度感知帧采样策略。该框架保持混合NVR的基本表示格式，可应用于不同骨干网络。
AI.result: 在UVG数据集上的实验表明，所提方法相比对应的NVR基线提升了重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过统一2×上采样与最小填充/裁剪构建分辨率灵活解码器，并结合中间监督与难度感知采样，在不改变混合NVR表示格式的前提下提升重建质量，且具备跨骨干网络的通用性。

title: Transferring Visual Explanations: How Cross-Architecture Knowledge Distillation Affects Model Interpretability
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to AJOSR
summary: Deploying efficient neural networks is essential in resource-constrained environments, yet compact models often sacrifice interpretability - a critical in safety-critical domains such as autonomous driving and medicine. This study investigates whether Knowledge Distillation transfers the spatial feature attribution of a large teacher network to a compact student. To assess the influence of the KD scheme on interpretability, we distill a ResNet-152 teacher into a ResNet-34 student on ImageNet-1K across five configurations by systematically varying the distillation temperature and soft-label loss weight. Models are evaluated on top-1 accuracy, along with two interpretability metrics: Relevance Mass Accuracy and Relevance Rank Accuracy. These metrics are computed via Grad-CAM heatmaps benchmarked against ground-truth object masks. Our results show that top-1 accuracy ranges from 71.6% to 74.0%. For Grad-CAM, RMA ranges from 7.7% to 9.7% and RRA from 7.3% to 10.1%; for Guided Grad-CAM, RMA ranges from 16.1% to 18.6% and RRA from 15.9% to 21.5%. Interpretability proves far more sensitive to the soft-label weight than to the temperature: keeping the student anchored to hard labels preserves both accuracy and coarse localization, whereas weighting the teacher heavily degrades both. Fine-grained attribution, however, fell below the undistilled baseline in every configuration tested, indicating that logit distillation transmits where a model attends more readily than the pixel-level structure of that attention. We evaluate 12 cross-architecture combinations of convolutional and transformer-based models, revealing that the inheritance of fine-grained spatial reasoning is fundamentally bottlenecked by the student's intrinsic structural biases. To our knowledge, this is the first application of this interpretability-aware evaluation framework - previously used for neural network pruning - to KD.

AI.tldr: 研究知识蒸馏是否可将大教师网络的空间特征归因迁移至紧凑学生网络：在ImageNet-1K上将ResNet-152蒸馏到ResNet-34，系统改变温度与软标签权重，并用Grad-CAM/Guided Grad-CAM的热力图对照真值掩码评估可解释性。
AI.motivation: 资源受限场景需要高效神经网络，但紧凑模型往往牺牲可解释性，而可解释性在自动驾驶、医学等安全关键领域至关重要。因此需考察知识蒸馏（KD）方案对可解释性的影响，并检验其能否传递教师的空间特征归因。
AI.method: 以ResNet-152为教师、ResNet-34为学生，在ImageNet-1K上按五种配置蒸馏，系统变化蒸馏温度与软标签损失权重。评估top-1准确率，以及基于Grad-CAM热力图对照真值目标掩码计算的两个可解释性指标：Relevance Mass Accuracy（RMA）与Relevance Rank Accuracy（RRA）；并扩展评估12种卷积与Transformer跨架构组合。该可解释性评估框架此前用于网络剪枝，本文首次用于KD。
AI.result: top-1准确率为71.6%–74.0%。Grad-CAM的RMA为7.7%–9.7%、RRA为7.3%–10.1%；Guided Grad-CAM的RMA为16.1%–18.6%、RRA为15.9%–21.5%。可解释性对软标签权重远比对温度敏感：学生锚定硬标签可保持准确率与粗粒度定位，而过度加权教师则使二者同时下降。但细粒度归因在所有配置下均低于未蒸馏基线。12种跨架构组合表明，细粒度空间推理的继承受学生内在结构偏置的根本性制约。
AI.conclusion: Logit蒸馏更易传递“模型关注何处”，而非该关注的像素级结构；细粒度空间归因的迁移受学生结构偏置瓶颈限制。KD中的可解释性继承具有选择性，且对软标签权重高度敏感。

title: When a Data Artifact Isn't a Shortcut: Causal Auditing of Synthetic RLVR Corpora
summary: Several recent pipelines build RLVR training data by masking a span of real corpus text and asking a language model to invent plausible wrong answers around it. The correct option is therefore genuine human prose; every distractor is synthetic. Correctness and provenance become entangled, and a policy could in principle learn the second instead of the first. We audit that possibility in GooseReason-0.7M. First we ask whether the asymmetry is visible at all: a classifier reading only five surface statistics (never the meaning) reaches AUROC 0.562 over 315,499 options, barely above chance. The aggregate hides something, though. Code sits at 0.416, below chance, and manual inspection explains why: code distractors turn out to be single-operator mutations of the gold answer rather than freely written alternatives, so the two classes are nearly identical by construction. Detecting a signal is not the same as showing a model uses it, so we then run an intervention. We build a paraphrase-matched control corpus, hold training-set size identical across arms, and train two policies under one fixed budget. The exploitation gap does not favour the unmodified-data arm: 0.021 against 0.027 for the control. Under our budget, in other words, a detectable artifact went unexploited. We think that dissociation, along with the domain-specific construction finding, is worth knowing for anyone curating corpora of this kind, and we release the audit as a mostly CPU-only protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了RLVR数据构建流程中"真实语料文本作为正确项、合成干扰项"所导致的正确性与来源纠缠问题，发现尽管存在可检测的表面伪影（整体AUROC 0.562，代码域0.416），但在固定预算的干预实验中该伪影未被策略利用（实验组0.021 vs 对照组0.027）。
AI.motivation: 近期多项RLVR流水线通过遮蔽真实语料片段并要求语言模型围绕其编造貌似合理的错误答案来构建训练数据。这使得正确选项为真实人类文本，而所有干扰项均为合成生成，导致"正确性"与"来源"两个属性相互纠缠，策略原则上可能学到来源而非正确性。作者希望审计这种可能性是否存在并被模型利用。
AI.method: 1) 在GooseReason-0.7M上先检验不对称性是否可见：训练一个仅读取五种表层统计特征（不看语义）的分类器，在315,499个选项上评估AUROC。2) 针对代码域异常进行人工检查。3) 进行干预实验：构建释义匹配的对照语料，保持各支训练集规模一致，在固定预算下训练两个策略，比较利用差距。
AI.result: 表层统计分类器整体AUROC仅0.562，略高于随机；代码域为0.416，低于随机。人工检查显示代码干扰项是对金标准答案的单算子变异，而非自由撰写的替代项，两类在构造上几乎相同。干预实验中，未修改数据组的利用差距为0.021，对照组为0.027，差距并未偏向未修改数据组。
AI.conclusion: 在本文预算下，可检测的伪影未被利用，呈现出"检测得到≠模型使用"的解离现象。这一解离及领域特定的构造发现对策划此类语料库的研究者具有参考价值。作者将该审计协议以几乎纯CPU的方式发布。

title: MaskVLA: Visual Masking Against Trajectory Overfitting of Vision-Language-Action Model
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate vision-language understanding with executable robot actions, enabling end-to-end learning for robot control. However, our empirical analysis reveals that existing models exhibit severe trajectory overfitting when finetuned on limited datasets. To guide the model in effectively utilizing wrist camera information, we propose MaskVLA, a masking-based fine-tuning strategy. By randomly masking a small portion of the main camera's visual information, the model is guided to autonomously learn more fine-grained, task-relevant, and effective visual features. This process leads to the emergence of robust policies, thereby enhancing the model's capability to tackle complex manipulation tasks and improving its generalization performance. Our method has been comprehensively evaluated on RoboTwin 2.0, achieving an average success rate improvement of 23.2% and 16.8% compared to $π_0$ and OpenVLA-OFT, respectively. Furthermore, experiments on real-world ALOHA robots also demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出MaskVLA：通过对主相机视觉信息随机掩码的微调策略，引导VLA模型学习腕部相机细粒度特征，缓解轨迹过拟合，提升操作任务成功率与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在有限数据上微调时存在严重的轨迹过拟合，且未能有效利用腕部相机信息。
AI.method: MaskVLA采用基于掩码的微调策略，随机遮蔽主相机部分视觉信息，促使模型自主利用腕部相机信息，学习更细粒度、任务相关且有效的视觉特征，从而形成鲁棒策略。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0上，相比π0与OpenVLA-OFT平均成功率分别提升23.2%与16.8%；真实ALOHA机器人实验亦验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: 掩码式微调可有效缓解轨迹过拟合，增强复杂操作能力与泛化性能，具有仿真与真实场景的适用性。

title: G6D: Geometric Learning-Free RGB-D 6D Pose Solver for Robotic Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Corresponding author: Chuxiong Hu. Project page: https://ai4control.github.io/G6D-Project-Page
summary: 6D object pose estimation is fundamental to robotic manipulation and automation. Recent zero-shot methods have significantly improved generalization to unseen objects, but most still rely on large-scale pretrained models with substantial GPU computation and memory demands. These requirements complicate deployment on robotic platforms where perception, planning, and control share limited computational resources, while learned intermediate representations offer limited geometric interpretability for task-specific adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose G6D, a learning-free, geometry-driven RGB-D 6D pose solver. Given an RGB-D observation, an object instance mask, camera intrinsics, and a CAD model, G6D generates pose hypotheses through template-based geometric matching and refines them using silhouette and depth consistency, forming a purely geometry-driven pose estimation paradigm. This paradigm requires neither pretrained visual models nor target-specific training and preserves interpretable geometric representations throughout pose estimation. Moreover, adjustable hypothesis counts provide flexible accuracy-computation trade-offs, while a CPU-only configuration supports deployment without GPU resources. Experiments on LineMOD and five BOP19 datasets demonstrate advanced performance. Real-world pick-and-place experiments further demonstrate G6D's applicability to robotic manipulation. The complete project is publicly available at https://ai4control.github.io/G6D-Project-Page .

AI.tldr: 提出G6D，一种无需学习、纯几何驱动的RGB-D 6D物体位姿求解器，通过模板几何匹配生成假设并用轮廓与深度一致性精修，在LineMOD与五个BOP19数据集上表现先进，并完成真机抓取实验。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本6D位姿方法多依赖大规模预训练模型，对GPU算力与显存需求高，难以部署于感知、规划、控制共享有限资源的机器人平台；且学习到的中间表征几何可解释性有限，不利于面向任务的自适应。因此需要一种低算力、高可解释性的位姿估计方案。
AI.method: G6D为无学习、几何驱动的RGB-D 6D位姿求解器。输入为RGB-D观测、物体实例掩码、相机内参与CAD模型；首先基于模板的几何匹配生成位姿假设，再通过轮廓一致性（silhouette）与深度一致性（depth）进行精修，形成纯几何位姿估计范式。方法无需预训练视觉模型与目标特定训练，全程保留可解释的几何表征；假设数量可调以权衡精度与计算量，并支持仅CPU配置部署。
AI.result: 在LineMOD及五个BOP19数据集上取得先进性能；真实场景抓取放置（pick-and-place）实验验证了其在机器人操作中的可用性。
AI.conclusion: G6D以纯几何范式实现了免训练、免GPU的6D位姿估计，兼顾精度、可解释性与部署灵活性，适用于机器人操作场景。项目已公开。

title: Contributions to the hierarchy of probabilistic languages
summary: We reconsider the theory of probabilistic formal languages generated by n-gram models and by probabilistic context-free grammars (PCFGs). The expected hierarchy of probabilistic grammars is established by proving that every probabilistic language generated by an n-gram model is also generated by some PCFG, while some probabilistic languages generated by PCFGs cannot be generated by any $n$-gram model. We introduce the notion of fully connected PCFGs, namely PCFGs in Chomsky normal form where every production rule only involving non-terminals has non-zero probability. Our main result shows that any probabilistic language generated by an $n$-gram model differs from any probabilistic language generated by a fully connected PCFG. Therefore, the class of probabilistic languages generated by $n$-gram models is not a subset of the class generated by fully connected PCFGs.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视n-gram模型与PCFG生成的概率形式语言理论，证明了概率文法层级，并引入全连通PCFG概念，证明n-gram生成的概率语言与全连通PCFG生成的概率语言不相交。
AI.motivation: 系统刻画n-gram模型与概率上下文无关文法（PCFG）在生成概率语言能力上的层级关系，厘清二者表达能力的差异与联系。
AI.method: 通过理论证明：首先证明任何n-gram模型生成的概率语言均可由某个PCFG生成，且存在PCFG生成而n-gram无法生成的概率语言，从而建立层级；随后引入全连通PCFG（Chomsky范式且所有含非终结符的产生式概率非零）的定义，并证明任一n-gram生成的概率语言与任一全连通PCFG生成的概率语言不同。
AI.result: 建立了概率文法层级：n-gram语言类真包含于PCFG语言类；且n-gram生成的概率语言与全连通PCFG生成的概率语言互不相同，即n-gram语言类不是全连通PCFG语言类的子集。
AI.conclusion: n-gram模型与全连通PCFG在概率语言生成能力上存在本质区别，二者语言类互不包含，进一步细化了概率文法表达能力的分层结构。

title: Does DCGAN-Based Synthetic Augmentation Improve Brain Tumor MRI Classification? An Empirical Study
summary: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) are increasingly used to augment medical imaging datasets, but synthetic images do not necessarily provide downstream classification benefits. This study investigates whether class-specific Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Network (DCGAN) augmentation improves brain tumor classification when the classifier and evaluation set are held constant. Experiments were conducted on 7,200 brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans across four classes: glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, and no tumor. For each class, 1,400 real images were used for training and 400 were reserved for testing. A baseline Swin Transformer classifier was trained using only the real training images and compared with a second model trained using the same real images augmented with 500 DCGAN-generated images per class. Both conditions were evaluated on the identical held-out test set. The two models achieved the same overall accuracy of 96%, while macro F1 remained effectively unchanged and ROC-AUC decreased slightly from 0.987 to 0.982 after augmentation. Class-level analysis showed small redistributions in errors rather than a consistent performance gain. FID values between real and synthetic images ranged from 209.15 to 314.27, indicating substantial distributional differences under the adopted evaluation setup. These results suggest that synthetic augmentation should not be assumed to improve medical image classification and should instead be evaluated for both distributional fidelity and downstream task utility.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了类别特定的DCGAN合成数据增强是否能提升脑肿瘤分类性能。在固定分类器与测试集的条件下，增强模型的整体准确率与基线相同（均为96%），ROC-AUC反而略降（0.987→0.982），FID值较高，表明合成图像与真实图像存在显著分布差异。作者结论：合成增强不应被默认为有益，需同时评估分布保真度与下游任务效用。
AI.motivation: 生成对抗网络（GAN）被越来越多地用于扩充医学影像数据集，但合成图像并不必然带来下游分类性能的提升。本文旨在验证在分类器与评估集保持固定的控制条件下，类别特定的DCGAN增强是否真正改善脑肿瘤分类。
AI.method: 基于7,200张脑部MRI扫描，覆盖四类（胶质瘤、脑膜瘤、垂体瘤、无肿瘤），每类使用1,400张真实图像训练、400张测试。以Swin Transformer为固定分类器，设置两个对照条件：仅用真实训练图像训练基线模型；在相同真实图像基础上加入每类500张DCGAN生成图像训练第二模型，并在同一留出测试集上评估。
AI.result: 两个模型整体准确率相同，均为96%；宏观F1基本不变；增强后ROC-AUC由0.987略降至0.982。类别层面的误差仅出现小幅重新分配，而非一致性的性能提升。真实图像与合成图像之间的FID为209.15至314.27，表明在当前评估设置下二者存在明显的分布差异。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据增强不应被假定能提升医学图像分类性能，而应同时评估其分布保真度与下游任务效用。

title: VibeMemBench: Evaluating Memory Systems for Coding Agents on Real Repository Coding Tasks
summary: Coding agents operate on real repository coding tasks, and persistent memory systems promise to reuse experience across tasks. Yet existing evaluations do not show whether those systems improve executable repository work. Repository benchmarks test code changes but do not isolate memory, while memory benchmarks score recall without measuring downstream coding outcomes. We introduce VibeMemBench, a benchmark for evaluating memory systems on 111 coding targets from 90 SWE-rebench V2 repositories and 3,634 history trajectories from the target repositories. The targets follow the SWE benchmark style and cover bug fixes, feature requests, interface changes, and configuration work. An agent edits each target codebase under a declared memory condition. Executable tests decide task resolution. Each target is retained only when injected history experience improves its executable outcome in a reference setting, so every target carries a prior experience whose usefulness is verified by execution in that setting. The frozen verified experience is then transferred to five held-out solvers. Direct injection raises observed task resolution on four of them by 1.1 to 4.5 percentage points while lowering agent steps on all five. Yet when four existing memory systems must construct and retrieve experience from the same history, eleven of twelve solver and system pairings fail to exceed the matched memory-off baseline. VibeMemBench exposes the gap between the useful experience that repository history holds and the experience existing memory systems deliver for repository coding tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 VibeMemBench，用于评估记忆系统在真实仓库编码任务中的可执行效果，揭示现有记忆系统未能有效利用仓库历史经验。
AI.motivation: 现有评测无法说明记忆系统是否真正改进可执行的仓库编码工作：仓库基准测试代码变更但不隔离记忆，记忆基准只测召回而不测下游编码结果。
AI.method: 构建 VibeMemBench，涵盖 90 个 SWE-rebench V2 仓库中的 111 个编码目标及 3634 条历史轨迹；目标风格遵循 SWE 基准，覆盖缺陷修复、功能需求、接口变更与配置工作。智能体在声明的记忆条件下修改目标代码库，由可执行测试判定任务是否解决。每个目标仅在注入历史经验能在参考设置中提升其可执行结果时才被保留，因此每个目标都带有经执行验证有效性的先验经验。冻结的已验证经验随后迁移到五个留出求解器上。
AI.result: 直接注入经验使五个求解器中的四个观测任务解决率提升 1.1 至 4.5 个百分点，同时使全部五者的智能体步数下降。但当四个现有记忆系统需从同一历史中构建并检索经验时，十二个求解器与系统配对中有十一个未能超过匹配的记忆关闭基线。
AI.conclusion: VibeMemBench 暴露了仓库历史所蕴含的有用经验与现有记忆系统为仓库编码任务所交付经验之间的差距。

title: Error-Supervised Synthetic Learner Writing for Automated Essay Scoring
summary: Synthetic essays can help reduce dependence on human-written data in Automated Essay Scoring (AES). However, they often lack realistic errors, limiting their ability to represent authentic human writing, particularly when the target texts are intended to resemble those produced by language learners. In this study, we present a simple approach that introduces error supervision into synthetic essay generation. Specifically, we fine-tune an LLM generator on error-annotated texts of the kind commonly used in Grammatical Error Detection (GED). To assess the utility of the proposed approach, we fine-tune and evaluate AES scorers under three data conditions: authentic essays, synthetic essays generated conventionally, and synthetic essays generated using our proposed approach. The results show that in the larger-data settings, the proposed approach outperforms the conventional synthetic baseline in 11 out of 12 dataset-metric comparisons, with performance in some cases approaching that of models trained on authentic essays. Despite these gains, performance under extremely low-resource settings remains mixed, with advantages over the conventional baseline only becoming more apparent at 200 training essays, although not consistently across datasets. Qualitative and quantitative analyses further show that the proposed approach produces learner-like errors whose distributions broadly resemble those observed in authentic essays.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种在合成作文生成中引入错误监督的简单方法：用错误标注文本微调LLM生成器，使合成作文包含接近真实学习者的错误。评估显示，在大数据量设置下，该方法在12项数据集-指标比较中11项优于传统合成基线，部分接近真实作文训练的效果；但在极低资源下表现不稳定。
AI.motivation: 合成作文可减少自动作文评分（AES）对人类写作数据的依赖，但常缺乏真实错误，难以代表真实人类写作，尤其是面向语言学习者的作文。
AI.method: 在错误标注文本（常用于语法错误检测GED的文本）上微调LLM生成器，将错误监督引入合成作文生成。随后在三种数据条件下微调并评估AES评分器：真实作文、传统方式生成的合成作文、以及本方法生成的合成作文。
AI.result: 在大数据量设置下，本方法在12项数据集-指标比较中的11项优于传统合成基线，部分情况性能接近用真实作文训练的模型。极低资源设置下结果混合，优势在200篇训练作文时才更明显，且跨数据集不一致。定性与定量分析表明，本方法生成的错误类似学习者错误，其分布大致接近真实作文中的错误分布。
AI.conclusion: 通过错误监督微调LLM生成器可提升合成作文的真实性与对AES的效用，尤其在数据量较大时表现突出，为减少AES对人类写作数据的依赖提供了可行路径；但在极低资源下仍有局限，需进一步改进。

title: ARID: A Deployable Edge AI System for Structured Information Extraction from Industrial Maintenance Work Orders
comment: Accepted for publication at IEEE IECON 2026. 5 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
summary: Maintenance work orders must often be processed offline on embedded hardware, yet downstream software requires predictable structured output. We present ARID (Aviation-inspired Routing for Industrial Deployment), which extracts component, failure mode, symptom, and maintenance action into fixed-schema JSON on an 8 GB NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. ARID combines conservative dual-teacher filtering, targeted noise-aware synthesis, one routing decision per work order, 4-bit inference, and grammar-constrained decoding. From 2,326 unlabeled OMIn records, it retains 716 training pairs and adds 99 topology-constrained records targeting action extraction. On 300 human-labeled records, ARID reaches 84.8% token-F1 on the reference stack and 82.9% on the deployed Jetson. Resident serving achieves 5,310/5,656 ms P50/P99 at 12.5 W. On zero-shot MaintNet transfer, semantic F1 falls to 46.4% while parser success remains at least 99.8%, showing that output validity transfers but field semantics do not.

AI.tldr: 提出ARID，一种面向嵌入式离线部署的维修工单结构化抽取框架，在Jetson Orin NX上实现固定JSON schema输出，兼顾精度、低功耗与输出合法性。
AI.motivation: 维修工单需在嵌入式硬件上离线处理，而下游软件要求可预测的结构化输出，现有方案难以同时满足算力受限、低功耗与schema合规的需求。
AI.method: ARID融合双教师保守过滤、定向噪声感知合成、每工单一次路由决策、4-bit量化推理与语法约束解码；从2,326条无标注OMIn记录中保留716对训练样本，并新增99条拓扑约束记录以强化动作抽取。
AI.result: 在300条人工标注记录上，参考栈token-F1为84.8%，Jetson部署环境为82.9%；常驻服务P50/P99延迟为5,310/5,656 ms，功耗12.5 W；零样本迁移至MaintNet时语义F1降至46.4%，但解析成功率仍≥99.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在嵌入式条件下实现了可用的抽取精度与严格输出合法性，但跨域迁移显示输出格式可迁移而字段语义不可迁移，语义泛化仍是主要瓶颈。

title: Global Ranks Survive, Selected Heads Shift: BOS-Sink Topology under 4-bit Weight-Only Quantization
comment: Accepted for publication at IEEE IECON 2026. 6 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables
summary: Sink-aware deployment may identify important first-token attention heads before a model is quantized, then reuse that map at the edge. We test when this shortcut is safe for 4-bit NF4 weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ). Our Sink Topology Consistency (STC) metrics separate global rank preservation, top-$k$ set overlap, and layerwise sink-mass shift, and distinguish per-input sensitivity from calibration-map transfer. Across Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Llama-3.2-1B, global bf16-to-4-bit ranks remain high at 4,096 tokens ($ρ_s \geq 0.980$), yet top-$k$ Jaccard overlap is only 0.619-0.793, corresponding to 76.5-88.5% membership retention. The global statistic also masks local failures: terminal Qwen layers shift by 6.2-7.9x their model means, whereas Llama-3.2-1B shows low, nearly uniform drift. Under a C4-to-LongBench shift, cross-domain overlap degrades more than the within-domain precision comparison for both Qwen models, but not for Llama-3.2-1B. Matched-domain 4-bit recalibration reaches 90% of a split-half stability plateau at the smallest tested $n=8$ for both Qwen models and $n=32$ for Llama-3.2-1B, though not as a sharp threshold; for the two Qwen models, updating only selected layers does not reach the full-map stability criterion. On Jetson Orin NX, the 16-sample workload takes seconds for the two models with valid on-device sink measurements. The practical message is precise: global rankings often transfer, but discrete head sets, layer-local policies, and cross-domain calibration should be revalidated after quantization.

AI.tldr: 本文通过STC指标检验了"先识别sink head、再迁移到边缘端4-bit NF4权重量化"这一捷径的安全性：全局排序可迁移，但离散head集合、层级策略与跨域校准需重新验证。
AI.motivation: Sink-aware部署可在量化前识别重要的首token attention head并复用到边缘端，但该捷径在4-bit NF4权重量化PTQ下的安全性缺乏系统验证。
AI.method: 提出Sink Topology Consistency(STC)指标，分解为全局排序保持、top-k集合重叠与层级sink质量漂移三个维度，并区分逐输入敏感性与校准映射迁移；在Qwen2.5-0.5B、Qwen2.5-1.5B、Llama-3.2-1B上测试bf16到4-bit的变化，涉及4096 token、C4到LongBench域迁移、匹配域4-bit重校准及Jetson Orin NX部署。
AI.result: 全局bf16到4-bit排序高度保持（ρ_s≥0.980），但top-k Jaccard仅0.619-0.793（成员保持率76.5-88.5%）；全局统计掩盖局部失败，Qwen末端层漂移达模型均值的6.2-7.9倍，Llama-3.2-1B漂移低且近乎均匀；C4到LongBench迁移下Qwen跨域重叠下降更明显；匹配域重校准在n=8（Qwen）和n=32（Llama）达90%稳定性平台；仅更新部分层无法满足Qwen的全图稳定性；Jetson Orin NX上16样本任务耗时数秒。
AI.conclusion: 全局排序通常可迁移，但离散head集合、层级局部策略与跨域校准应在量化后重新验证，不能仅依赖量化前的sink-aware映射。

title: An Efficient and Effective Watermarking Scheme for the Protection of the Intellectual Property Rights of Video Generative Models
summary: The rapid development of video generative models (VGMs) has enabled the generation of highly realistic synthetic videos, raising concerns about the intellectual property rights (IPR) of these models. In particular, two closely related forensic tasks remain largely unaddressed: synthetic video verification (determining whether a video was generated by a protected VGM) and model ownership verification (determining whether a suspect VGM is an unauthorized copy of a protected VGM). In this paper, we propose a new in-generation watermarking scheme that can address the two verification tasks. First, a novel video watermarking network named VidMark is presented, which incorporates a two-scale discrete wavelet transform (DWT) decomposition and a global temporal attention block (GTAB) to enhance watermark robustness and imperceptibility. Second, we present a decoder-guided fine-tuning procedure. By leveraging the frozen VidMark decoder, this process enables VGMs to synthesize videos carrying an imperceptible, robust, and model-specific watermark. Finally, two verification frameworks are established to perform synthetic video verification and model ownership verification. Extensive experiments on representative VGMs demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves over 99% watermark extraction accuracy and 100% verification accuracy on both tasks, with negligible impact on video generation quality. Furthermore, the watermarks exhibit strong robustness against a comprehensive range of video-level and model-level attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"生成中"视频水印方案，包含VidMark水印网络（两级DWT+全局时序注意力）与解码器引导微调，实现合成视频验证与模型所有权验证两个取证任务，水印提取准确率>99%、验证准确率100%，且对视频级与模型级攻击具有强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型（VGM）快速发展带来高逼真合成视频，引发知识产权（IPR）保护问题。两个密切相关的取证任务尚未得到解决：合成视频验证（判断某视频是否由受保护的VGM生成）与模型所有权验证（判断可疑VGM是否为受保护VGM的未授权副本）。
AI.method: 提出"生成中"（in-generation）水印方案：1）VidMark视频水印网络，引入两级离散小波变换（DWT）分解与全局时序注意力模块（GTAB），提升鲁棒性与不可感知性；2）解码器引导微调流程，利用冻结的VidMark解码器使VGM生成携带不可感知、鲁棒、模型专属水印的视频；3）建立两个验证框架分别完成合成视频验证与模型所有权验证。
AI.result: 在代表性VGM上实验表明：水印提取准确率超过99%，两个任务验证准确率均达100%，对视频生成质量影响可忽略；水印对全面的视频级与模型级攻击表现出强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该生成中水印方案可同时支持合成视频验证与模型所有权验证，兼顾高精度、高鲁棒性与生成质量无损，为VGM的知识产权保护提供有效手段。

title: On the Efficiency-Safety Dilemma in Large Reasoning Models
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) incur high inference costs, often mitigated by efficiency techniques like quantization and pruning. However, the impact of these techniques on model adversarial robustness remains largely unexplored. This study provides the first comprehensive analysis of the interplay between efficiency, jailbreak vulnerability, and reasoning in LRMs. We find that while efficiency methods seemingly reduce the success rate of jailbreak attacks, this improvement is often superficial. It largely arises from degraded reasoning capabilities leading to "attempted but failed" malicious responses, rather than an increase in genuine alignment. Mechanistic analysis of representational drift confirms this, revealing a strict coupling between reasoning capability loss and the model's inability to maintain malicious semantic trajectories. Additionally, we identify quantization with pruning as the optimal strategy to balance efficiency and robustness. These findings clarify the distinction between true safety alignment and capability-induced failure, providing an empirical foundation for LRM deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统分析大型推理模型(LRM)中效率技术(量化、剪枝)与越狱脆弱性、推理能力之间的相互作用，发现效率方法表面降低越狱成功率实则源于推理能力退化，并确认量化结合剪枝是平衡效率与鲁棒性的最优策略。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型(LRM)推理成本高昂，常通过量化和剪枝等效率技术缓解，但这些技术对模型对抗鲁棒性(尤其是越狱安全性)的影响尚未被充分探索，亟需厘清效率与安全之间的权衡关系。
AI.method: 对LRM中效率、越狱脆弱性与推理三者的交互关系进行综合分析；通过表征漂移的机制性分析，考察推理能力损失与模型维持恶意语义轨迹能力之间的关系，并对比量化与剪枝及其组合策略。
AI.result: 效率方法表面降低越狱攻击成功率，但该改善是虚假的，主要源于推理能力退化导致的"试图但失败"的恶意回应，而非真正的对齐增强；表征漂移分析证实推理能力损失与无法维持恶意语义轨迹之间存在严格耦合；量化结合剪枝是平衡效率与鲁棒性的最优策略。
AI.conclusion: 本研究厘清了真实安全对齐与能力诱发失败之间的区别，为LRM的实际部署提供了实证基础。

title: Collapse, Not Complexity: Failure-Conditioned Decomposition Repair for End-to-End Document Parsing
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: End-to-end document parsers increasingly offer an optional reasoning mode for complex pages. On a 180-page entropy-stratified discovery sample with one frozen 4B checkpoint, complexity is the wrong decision variable. Reasoning lowers mean quality by 2.21 Overall at 1.54x tokens; a preregistered input-only model cannot predict its signed benefit (held-out AUROC 0.47, indistinguishable from chance). The benefit concentrates on pages whose ordinary pass has already collapsed, and they do not look complex: shared collapses have lower layout entropy than healthy ones yet consume 19x the tokens as degenerate repetition that doubling the budget does not cure. Switching modes rarely repairs them: 83% recur under reasoning. We instead detect collapse from the ordinary-pass trace, decompose the page by projection, and re-parse each region. Repair gains 1.40 Overall (95% CI [0.68, 2.16]) at 1.13x tokens, replicates across three checkpoints, and, with all parameters frozen, gains 2.41 (CI [1.64, 3.46]) on the remaining 1,175 benchmark pages.

AI.tldr: 在端到端文档解析器中，推理模式并非按页面复杂度触发；作者发现推理仅对“普通流程已崩溃”的页面有效，且这类页面熵更低、并非复杂页面。据此提出基于普通流程轨迹的崩溃检测与投影分解重解析方法，在仅增加1.13倍token的情况下获得1.40分的性能提升，并在更大基准上复现。
AI.motivation: 端到端文档解析器日益提供可选的推理（reasoning）模式以处理复杂页面，但"复杂度"是否是正确的触发判据尚不明确。作者希望检验：推理模式的收益是否可由输入页面的复杂度预测，以及如何更有效地决定何时/如何启用推理或修复。
AI.method: 采用180页、按熵分层的发现集，冻结一个4B模型检查点；检验复杂度与推理收益的关系，做预注册的仅输入预测模型并评估其留出AUROC；从普通流程（ordinary-pass）轨迹中检测崩溃（collapse），并按投影（projection）对页面分区域重新解析；在三个检查点上复现，并在其余1175页基准上以全冻结参数验证。
AI.result: 推理使平均质量下降2.21 Overall，token消耗为1.54倍；预注册的仅输入模型无法预测其带符号收益（留出AUROC 0.47，与随机无异）。收益集中于普通流程已崩溃的页面，这些页面布局熵低于健康页面却消耗19倍token（表现为退化重复），加倍预算也无法修复，83%在推理下仍复现。所提修复方法提升1.40 Overall（95% CI [0.68, 2.16]），token为1.13倍，跨三个检查点复现；在全冻结参数下，在其余1175页上提升2.41（CI [1.64, 3.46]）。
AI.conclusion: 复杂度并非决定是否使用推理模式的正确变量；推理收益集中于普通流程已崩溃且外观并不复杂的页面。基于普通流程轨迹的崩溃检测与投影分解重解析是更高效的替代方案，在低token开销下带来稳定且可复现的性能提升。

title: StyleAT: Defending Face Recognition Against Semantic Attacks
comment: Accepted at the 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026), Lancaster, UK. 14 pages main text plus 13 pages of appendices, 15 figures, 12 tables
summary: With face-recognition models now embedded in everyday authentication and surveillance, recent works have pinpointed a critical weakness: these models remain acutely vulnerable to adversarial semantic edits. I.e., adversarially produced semantic alterations to the input, such as slight aging or pose changes, can induce misclassifications. Certain existing attacks are powerful, but they can be computationally costly, rendering them inadequate for developing defenses (e.g., through adversarial training). To fill the gap, we introduce BoundStyle, a potent semantic attack operating in StyleGAN's rich latent space to maximize misclassification rates. Notably, BoundStyle achieves high attack success rates while being ${\sim}{\times}9.5$ faster than existing state-of-the-art attacks, making it suitable for adversarial training. Building on BoundStyle, we develop StyleAT, an efficient adversarial training scheme that incorporates low-budget attack variants yet defends against stronger and unseen semantic attacks. We evaluate on two datasets unseen during training and seven models, and find that StyleAT boosts robust accuracy against state-of-the-art attacks and outperforms common defenses in various settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出BoundStyle——一种在StyleGAN潜空间中进行的高效语义对抗攻击，速度比现有SOTA快约9.5倍且攻击成功率很高；并基于此提出StyleAT对抗训练方案，在未见过的数据集和多种模型上提升了对抗语义攻击的鲁棒准确率。
AI.motivation: 人脸识别模型广泛应用于身份认证与监控，但对其语义编辑（如轻微老化、姿态变化）的对抗攻击十分脆弱。现有语义攻击虽强，却计算代价高昂，难以用于对抗训练等防御手段的开发，因此需要一种高效且强力的语义攻击方法。
AI.method: 提出BoundStyle，在StyleGAN丰富的潜空间中操作以最大化误分类率的语义攻击，兼顾高成功率与高效率（比现有SOTA快约9.5倍）。基于BoundStyle进一步开发StyleAT对抗训练方案，融合低预算攻击变体，但仍能防御更强、未见过的语义攻击。
AI.result: 在两个训练时未见过的数据集和七个模型上进行评估，StyleAT在抵御SOTA攻击时的鲁棒准确率得到提升，并在多种设置下优于常见防御方法。
AI.conclusion: BoundStyle以高效率和强攻击性弥补了现有语义攻击计算昂贵的不足，为对抗训练提供了可行基础；StyleAT作为高效对抗训练方案，能有效提升对强大及未见语义攻击的鲁棒性。

title: PETR: Prompt Ensembling with Training-free Routing for Vision-Language Models
summary: Prompt learning efficiently adapts vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks, but gains on seen classes often come at the expense of generalization to unseen classes. To address this limitation, we propose prompt ensembling with training-free routing (PETR), whose key innovation is a carefully designed dual-prompt architecture: two complementary prompts are learned from different data and objectives to emphasize seen class discrimination and unseen-class generalization, respectively. During training, both prompts are fine-tuned using a shared frozen CLIP backbone, and statistical information is collected from the training set logits. At inference time, we determine the similarity of each test sample to seen data, and route the sample to the most appropriate prompt branch. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first prompt tuning framework that performs training-free adaptive routing based on statistical similarity. This design provides an interpretable routing signal and avoids common MoE-style routing pathologies, such as router training instability and load imbalance. Extensive experiments on 11 benchmark datasets demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms previous methods on both seen and unseen classes, achieving new state-of-the-art results.

AI.tldr: 提出PETR（双提示+免训练路由），在11个数据集上同时提升可见类与未见类性能，达到新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 提示学习能高效地将视觉-语言模型（VLM）适配到下游任务，但对可见类性能的提升往往以牺牲对未见类的泛化能力为代价，需要兼顾两者的方案。
AI.method: 核心是双提示架构：两个互补提示分别在不同数据与目标下学习，一个侧重可见类判别，另一个侧重未见类泛化；训练时二者在共享的冻结CLIP骨干上微调，并从训练集logits中收集统计信息。推理时计算测试样本与可见数据的相似度，据此将样本路由到最合适的提示分支，实现免训练自适应路由。
AI.result: 在11个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该框架在可见类和未见类上均持续优于此前方法，取得新的最先进结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次实现基于统计相似度的免训练自适应路由提示微调框架，提供可解释的路由信号，避免MoE式路由的训练不稳定与负载不均衡问题，有效缓解提示学习中的可见-未见类权衡。

title: PREM: Prefix-Steered Recurrent Memory for Long-Video Understanding
summary: Long-video understanding must capture transient visual evidence under strict token budgets, yet existing methods compress frames, append memory tokens, or alter internal key-value (KV) caches. We introduce Prefix-Steered Recurrent Memory (PREM), a memory-token-free framework for frozen vision-language models (VLMs). PREM separates video ingestion from query answering: a recurrent writer distills visual streams into a compact 256 KiB multi-slot associative state, while a question-conditioned readout adds memory-derived key/value (K/V) steering modulations to existing non-visual prompt prefixes during prefill. This enables write-once, query-many inference without extra prompt tokens or decoding recurrence. Across six long-video benchmarks in offline and streaming end-of-stream settings, PREM consistently outperforms frozen baselines at every evaluated visual budget. Under a constrained budget of 16 frames, PREM improves macro-average accuracy by 3.06% on Qwen2.5-VL-3B, with gains of 11.0% on action antonym identification and 9.9% on localized needle retrieval. These gains require tuning 0.24% of backbone parameters at 0.03 GiB of peak GPU memory overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出PREM，一种无需记忆token的冻结VLM长视频理解框架，通过循环写入器将视频流压缩为256 KiB关联状态，并在预填充阶段以问题条件读出的K/V调制实现写一次、查询多次的高效推理。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解需在严格token预算下捕捉瞬态视觉证据，但现有方法依赖压缩帧、附加记忆token或修改内部KV缓存，存在额外开销或需改动模型结构的问题。
AI.method: PREM将视频摄入与问题回答解耦：循环写入器将视觉流蒸馏为紧凑的256 KiB多槽关联状态；问题条件读出在预填充阶段向现有非视觉提示前缀注入由记忆导出的K/V引导调制，无需额外提示token或解码循环。
AI.result: 在六个长视频基准的离线与流式端到端设置中，各视觉预算下均优于冻结基线；16帧预算下，Qwen2.5-VL-3B宏平均准确率提升3.06%，动作反义识别提升11.0%，局部化检索提升9.9%；仅需调优0.24%主干参数，峰值GPU内存开销0.03 GiB。
AI.conclusion: PREM以极小的参数与显存代价，在冻结VLM上实现了高效且一致的长视频理解提升，验证了无记忆token、基于K/V调制方案的有效性。

title: Beyond UV Mapping: Mesh Texture Compression via Surface-Aligned Texture Fields
summary: Mesh texture compression typically relies on 2D UV atlases, whose chart discontinuities and mapping overhead can limit coding efficiency. To tackle this challenge, we introduce TexF, a surface-aligned texture field that organizes texture attributes in sparse voxels derived from the mesh surface. This representation supports high-resolution textures while preserving local 3D correlations for compression and enabling direct surface queries. For bitstream compression, TexF reuses established 3D attribute codecs, with voxel locations reconstructed from the decoded mesh without separate transmission. For GPU-resident compression, we develop 3DNTC, which combines quantized hash features with a lightweight decoder for random-access reconstruction at surface positions. Differentiable rendering enables image-space refinement of both voxel attributes and compressed neural fields. Experiments on the MPEG and AOM mesh compression benchmarks demonstrate improved average rate-distortion performance over representative UV-based methods for both bitstream and GPU-resident compression. 3DNTC also supports real-time rendering.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出TexF——一种表面对齐的纹理场，利用从网格表面稀疏体素组织纹理属性，避免2D UV图集的映射开销，并开发GPU端方案3DNTC，在压缩与实时渲染上均优于代表性UV方法。
AI.motivation: 传统网格纹理压缩依赖2D UV图集，其图集分片不连续性与映射（mapping）开销会限制编码效率。作者希望解决这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出TexF表面对齐纹理场，将纹理属性组织于由网格表面导出的稀疏体素中，保留局部3D相关性并支持表面直接查询。码流压缩复用现有3D属性编解码器，体素位置从解码网格重建、无需额外传输；GPU驻留方案3DNTC结合量化哈希特征与轻量解码器实现表面位置的随机访问重建；并通过可微渲染在图像空间对体素属性与压缩神经场进行细化。
AI.result: 在MPEG与AOM网格压缩基准上，无论码流压缩还是GPU驻留压缩，其平均率失真（RD）性能均优于代表性UV方法；3DNTC还支持实时渲染。
AI.conclusion: 表面对齐的稀疏体素纹理表示可有效规避UV映射开销，兼容既有3D编解码器，并通过神经场与可微渲染实现高效的GPU随机访问与实时渲染。
